questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) you swim when you were five?
questions.explanation: 過去（when you were five）の能力は could。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: You (   ) not smoke here. It's against the rules.
questions.explanation: must not は「〜してはいけない（禁止）」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It (   ) rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella just in case.
questions.explanation: might は「〜かもしれない」（弱い推量）。just in case（念のため）と合う。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: You don't (   ) to come if you are busy.
questions.explanation: don't have to は「〜する必要はない」。must not（禁止）とは意味が違う。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) I carry your bag? ― Yes, please.
questions.explanation: Shall I 〜? は「（私が）〜しましょうか」という申し出。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.explanation: ought to do は「〜すべきだ」。to が続くのは ought だけ。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.explanation: Would you like 〜? は「〜はいかがですか」とていねいに勧める表現。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) I come tomorrow? ― No, you needn't.
questions.explanation: Must I 〜?（〜しなければなりませんか）への「いいえ」は needn't / don't have to。
